fields.name: nightfall_api_key
fields.description: The Nightfall API key to scan your logs with, obtainable from the [Nightfall Dashboard](https://app.nightfall.ai)

fields.name: policy_id
fields.description: The Nightfall developer platform policy to scan your logs with, configurable in the [Nightfall Dashboard](https://app.nightfall.ai/developer-platform/policies).

fields.name: sampling_rate
fields.description: The rate controlling how much of your logs you wish to be scanned.

fields.name: tls.ca_path
fields.description: Absolute path to root certificates, required if tls.verify is true.

fields.name: tls.verify
fields.description: When enabled, turns on certificate validation when connecting to the Nightfall API.

fields.name: tls.vhost
fields.description: Set an optional TLS virtual host for the Nightfall API connection.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
